product.title: “Private Acadia” & Mount Desert Island Tour (full day, six hours)

description.text: Explore the beauty of Acadia National Park on this comprehensive six-hour private tour. Discover breathtaking landscapes and charming local spots while enjoying a delicious lunch stop at a popular lobster pound. Stops include Park Loop Road, Cadillac Mountain, Mount Desert Island, Lobster Pound. This tour is designed to help you make the most of your day beyond Acadia’s Park Loop Road, covering key attractions with a private guide. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
